nodes.label: Next.js Breaking Changes Notice
nodes.rationale: This project uses a modified/non-standard version of Next.js whose APIs, conventions, and file structure may differ from the assistant's training data. Agents are instructed to read the relevant guide in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any code and to heed deprecation notices, to avoid applying outdated or incorrect Next.js patterns.

links.label: possibly part of default Next.js create-next-app starter icon set

links.explanation: globe.svg is a 16x16 viewBox line-art globe/world icon (single #666 fill-rule path depicting latitude/longitude arcs on a circle) matching the style and naming convention of the default icons (globe.svg, file.svg, window.svg, next.svg, vercel.svg) bundled with the Next.js create-next-app scaffold in the public/ directory.

links.notes: window.svg is a 16x16 outline icon (rounded rectangle frame with three small dots) matching the default icon bundled with Next.js create-next-app scaffolding (alongside file.svg, globe.svg, next.svg, vercel.svg); not explicitly labeled as such in the SVG markup itself.
